abilities.critical_failure: As failure but 16d10 damage and enfeebled 2.
abilities.effect: The pain milker emits a shrill whine and exudes a blast of violet light. All creatures in area B2 must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save. This DC is reduced by 2 if the machine is broken.
abilities.failure: The creature takes 8d10 positive or negative damage (whichever is more harmful) and is enfeebled 1.
abilities.name: Agonizing Overload
abilities.success: The creature takes 4d10 positive or negative damage (whichever is more harmful).

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

abilities.trigger: The pain milker is struck hard enough to take damage, or any of its dials and levers are adjusted carelessly

hazard.description: An eerie machine made of levers, crystals, and glowing bits of metal that, as one draws near, causes unsettling aches and pains.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) to deactivate the machine, or DC 38 Perception (expert) to decipher the proper order in which the switches and dials should be adjusted in order to power the device down harmlessly
hazard.name: Pain Milker
hazard.reset: If the augnagar still lives and at least one crystallized agony is still functional, the pain milker resets automatically in a number of rounds equal to 7 – the number of remaining crystallized agonies.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
